text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali discusses investment policy with Prime Minister Hamed Karoui.
- Junior minister for information Fethi Houidi said Tunisia's policy on media was based on pluralism and freedom of expression.
- Tunisia aims at self-sufficiency in milk production by the year 2000.
- Tax evasion phenomenon was discussed at a conference attended by magistrates and finance ministry officials.
- Highlights of new fiscal law on properties.
- Trade deficit cut in January to under 100 million dinars from 170.8 million dinars.
